description: Reviewed mapping from Discogs genre and style names to MusicBrainz genre names, for names that do not match by normalized name. "map" maps a name to one or more genres; "notGenres" lists names that are not musical genres in the MusicBrainz vocabulary (formats, spoken content, release purposes such as soundtracks). Names absent from both lists are unreviewed and are not used; ingest reports them. Only unambiguous mappings are listed: vague names (Modern, Contemporary, Hardcore, Acid, Beat, Abstract, Minimal, Tribal, Vocal, Holiday) stay unmapped rather than guessed.
